lines.t: Mountains bow low, rivers stand still
The skies declare His holy will
The stars sing songs they can't conceal
Every knee will know his name
King of all, King, the Lord of lords
He reigns forever, his love restores
He speaks the storm, it fades away
The sun obeys his light of day
His mercy floods where shadows lay
King of all, king of all, king of
Two of all, we got you at the door
